mentions.name: hashtagcode
mentions.description: This app lets recruiters quickly create online multiple-choice coding tests to screen and evaluate job applicants, with a default 15-minute test spanning a few different domains. It is currently free with 1000 invites to gather feedback, with monetization planned later.
mentions.problem: Recruiters needed a simple, quick way to create coding tests to screen people applying for jobs, and the process needed to be quick and easy for applicants.
mentions.audience: Recruiters creating coding tests to screen job applicants, and applicants taking the tests.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I recently launched one of my small side projects. It's quick online multiple choice code tests aimed at recruiters to evaluate applicants: https://hashtagcode.io

The goal was to make a simple way for recruiters to create coding tests to screen people applying for jobs, and to make the process quick and easy for applicants. The default is a 15 minute multiple choice test across a few different domains.
